card.name: Last letter of cIAI abbreviation
card.fires_on: The final "I" of the abbreviation cIAI (complicated intra-abdominal infection) in antibiotic labels. It appears where dosing, duration or trial results for this infection are given.

modes.label: cIAI in dosing text
modes.description: The abbreviation ends a phrase about treating cIAI, often near metronidazole or treatment duration.
modes.example: For treatment of cIA<<I>>, metronidazole should be given

modes.label: cIAI in trial or table text
modes.description: The abbreviation appears in headings about adult patients, cure rates or clinical response.
